entries.subject: DAMIT 1802: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 1802, version 2017-06-19, pole (223°, -41°), period 4.116391 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 73 ± 3 km, volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model. DAMIT marks model 1802 as size-calibrated (D = 73 km, σ = 3 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 73 ± 3 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 23 light curves and 2 occultations, with no adaptive-optics image (Table 3).
